prompt:
Challenge C036-CH2: Big retailers will stop taking conventional plastic lidding film by 2028; we need a compostable one that still seals.
Detail: Several large

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research on seal-layer formulations for multilayer films addresses adjustments to achieve specific seal strength and thermal processing windows through resin blending and thickness optimization.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08004","field":"abstract","quote":"partial substitution of the mLLDPE base resin with a 1-octene-based very-low-density polyethylene"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07999","field":"abstract","quote":"Seal-layer thickness was varied at 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 µm while total film gauge was held"}]},{"text":"Work on heat-sealable film formulation development includes laboratory characterization of seal strength, hot-tack performance, and sealing temperature ranges on cast-film and VFFS equipment.","sources":[{"id":"R0715","field":"keywords","quote":"heat-sealable films, seal-layer formulation, thermal processing window"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08004","field":"abstract","quote":"VLDPE addition at 20 wt% lowered SIT by 9 °C and enabled 26 N/25 mm plateau seal strength"}]},{"text":"Research has evaluated thermal stability and aging effects on film properties including seal strength retention and crystallinity changes relevant to shelf-life performance.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08000","field":"abstract","quote":"Seal strength dropped by 12–17 % relative to the unaged films, attributed to increased crystallinity"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has strong expertise in seal-layer formulation, thermal processing windows, and heat-seal characterization [SYN-PUB-08004, SYN-PUB-07999], but the publications focus on conventional polyolefins (mLLDPE, OPP) rather than compostable polymer systems like PLA or other biodegradable materials needed for EN 13432 compliance and the specific anti-fog and gas-transmission requirements for soft fruit packaging."}
